study type: Systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies
cohort: The study included 243 pregnant women with PAS and 1599 pregnant women without PAS from eight observational studies.
finding: Pregnant women with PAS had significantly higher first-trimester serum PAPP-A levels, and a high first-trimester serum PAPP-A level was associated with an increased PAS risk (odds ratio: 2.89, 95% CI: 2.13 to 3.92).
